edits.new: | Guardrails | No business value in code; no personal data in logs, tests or prompts; ACE data only through `recovery.v_ace_*`; a break never deletes or changes a record | Section 17. Personal data is handled as Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5 states: `account_key` (Indirect identifier, Confidential) travels in events and workflow inputs as a reference only, the clear key is read by REST under the masking policy, and logs carry the id of the read only; `days_past_due`, `total_balance` and `data_as_of` of `v_ace_account` (Customer data, Confidential) travel as a business fact only, never beside a direct identifier, and logs carry a code or an id only, never the customer value |
